title: Deterministic Risk / Epistemic Diversity / Escalation Routing
implemented_contracts: deterministic L0-L4 routing-risk classification with explainable integer factors and policy versioning
mechanical failure and critical/counterexample objections impose L4 hard floors
major and formalization-mismatch objections impose at least L3 routing burden
Atlas difficulty and direct downstream centrality are computed from canonical Atlas structure
materialization priority is recorded but not treated as correctness probability
six-axis epistemic-diversity topology over model family, prompt, context, source set, tool set and verification goal
model-version string changes alone do not increase effective review topology diversity
three-or-more same-family/context/source/tool reviews emit pseudo_independent_consensus warning
disagreements are grouped by issue and remain open regardless of support/oppose vote counts
escalation decisions follow deterministic priority rules and never execute providers
cross-artifact candidate revision identities are checked before routing
escalation validators rederive route, blocking, reasons and open disagreement IDs from the same deterministic policy
pre-cap risk-factor contributions may exceed 100 while final risk_score remains capped to 0-100

live_integration.epistemic_boundary: routing risk and review topology only; no truth probability, provider execution, or canonical verdict

known_boundaries.risk: routing burden is not a probability of mathematical error
known_boundaries.diversity: review topology independence is not confidence or truth
known_boundaries.disagreement: open disagreement records conflict and does not select a winner
known_boundaries.escalation: high_assurance_review_required is a provider-neutral marker; R5 does not call frontier or human adjudicators
known_boundaries.mechanical_trust: R5 consumes R4 status but does not replace the candidate/source-bound R4 Mechanical Trust Report

final_head_verification.reason: committing this validation artifact creates a new branch HEAD that must independently pass OCME CI and Lean CI

acceptance_rule: R5 is FINAL_ACCEPTED only after the validation-artifact HEAD passes both OCME CI and Lean CI.
